description: Proposed external works: Repair and if necessary replace like-for-like structural timbers to roof; Replace concrete roof tiles with Welsh slate; Add Code 5 lead lining to front and valley gutters; Lead covering flashing applied to junctions of roof with external wall; Removal of uPVC light funnel; Cowls added to chimneys;  Render repairs to front elevation; Cill repairs; Removal of redundant cables to elevations; Repointing of brickwork to front and rear elevations;  Replacing of hopper, rainwater down pipes and svp; repairs to timber windows where necessary; Add an overdoor fanlight to front door;  Repairs to flat roof and secret gutter to existing extension; Removal of coal shed to garden;  New external storage and seating solutions; Redecoration of all painted and treated elements of the exterior; Alterations to external steps to garden; New brick garden wall to boundary with No 9 Arbour Square. Proposed internal works: Minor damp repairs to damp damaged plaster; New kitchen in existing location; changes to chimney breast; New floorboards to ground floor; Minor alterations to bathroom layout; New floorboards to first floor bathroom; Cupboards removed from first floor living room;  Repair and redecoration of coving to first floor living room; Wood burner installed to living room; Minor change to chimney breasts at second floor;  New doors throughout house; New window and door architraves and skirting throughout house; Removal of non-historic coving throughout house; New radiators throughout house; Cupboard doors replaced with doors to match internal doors and Redecoration (painting whole house).
